Hi. My partner had her b2 visa extended last time we were in misrad hapnim for submission of our b1 application. She will be traveling to Germany next week. We are in the process for b1 and will have an interview in September. Do I understand correctly that she needs to go before to notify them she is leaving the country for a week or does the b2 suffice for reentering? 

Also, we have an infant son and I’m in the process of registering as the father (DNa test not yet happened so I’m not yet the father officially). She will exit and enter with him and he only has a German passport. Anything to consider vis a vis him?
